scripts.start: cd frontend && npm install && npm start
scripts.install-deps: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run backend:dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && (../.venv-test/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload || ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload || python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload)
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev" "wait-on tcp:3000 tcp:8000 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3000 DESKTOP_EXTERNAL_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 electron ."
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run desktop:build:frontend && npm run desktop:build:sidecar && electron-builder --mac
